No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. View/perspective: wide intimate view from slightly above; same gentle light from upper left. Palette dominant berry red (#B85466) with natural object colours. Render exactly five independent painted foreground details on TRUE transparent alpha in a strict3-column by2-row grid, aspect3:2, target2400x1600. Each cell800x800, at least96pxtransparent gutter on every side; no overlap between cells. Bottom-right sixth cell MUST remain completely transparent. No labels, numbers, frames, sky backdrop or contact shadow. Paint only the requested detail for each cell; do not bake rectangular scenery around it. cell(1,1): a short scene-specific fabric pennant; cell(2,1): a soft awning tassel; cell(3,1): a small flower sprig matching the stall; cell(1,2): a leafy branch entering from the left; cell(2,2): a tied ribbon from one displayed package. These details are actual parts of the completed painting, not generic decorative particles. Design each isolated silhouette to fit the placement and perspective of this exact scene.
Production isolation is essential: each painted item must fit well inside its own grid cell, using at most60% of that cell width/height, with a completely transparent buffer between all five objects. No artwork crosses a cell boundary. Precisely these distinct subjects: top-left one short triangular faded-cream pennant with a berry-red sewn edge hanging vertically from a tiny horizontal attachment seam; top-middle one soft ivory cotton awning tassel with a short straight cord above; top-right one small white daisy blossom on a long olive-green stem for a blue-and-cream bud vase; bottom-left one slim olive sprig with muted green leaves extending up-right from a visible short woody base; bottom-middle one curled berry-red silk gift ribbon bow with two tails, viewed slightly from above to lie on a small brown-paper parcel. No vases, gift boxes, wall, awning or props behind any part. Same warm upper-left sunlight and softly painted ceramic-shop illustration style. Real transparent alpha, not a checkerboard or opaque colored matte. Bottom-right cell empty.
